# Reclaim

> Reclaim is a free, open-source macOS app that finds and cleans wasted
> developer storage. It measures a curated catalogue of known cache
> locations across build systems, IDEs, package managers, runtimes and
> AI tools, finds regenerable artifacts inside the project folders you
> add, rates each item Safe, Caution or Destructive, and moves what
> you choose to the Trash. Nothing about your machine leaves it.

- [Home](https://reclaim-app.dev/): what Reclaim covers, the safety model and the download
- [Support](https://reclaim-app.dev/support/): common questions and recovery steps
- [Privacy](https://reclaim-app.dev/privacy/): what the app reads, and what leaves the Mac
- [Source](https://github.com/allwiine/Reclaim): MIT-licensed repository
- [Releases](https://github.com/allwiine/Reclaim/releases): downloads and changelog
